en: What could octopuses possibly have in common with us?
zh: 章魚和我們怎麼可能有共通點？

en: After all, they don't have lungs, spines, or even a plural noun we can all agree on.
zh: 畢竟牠們沒有肺、沒有脊椎甚至連個公認的英文複數型都沒有

en: But what they do have is the ability to solve puzzles, learn through observation, and even use tools,
zh: 但牠們的確有解謎的能力能透過觀察以學習甚至能夠使用工具

en: just like some other animals we know.
zh: 就像我們所知的某些動物一樣

en: And what makes octopus intelligence so amazing is that it comes from a biological structure completely different from ours.
zh: 章魚的智力之所以如此驚人在於牠們的生物結構完全與人類不同

en: The 200 or so species of octopuses are mollusks belonging to the order cephalopoda, Greek for head-feet.
zh: 章魚大約有 200 種品種屬於「頭足綱」的軟體動物希臘語就是「頭足」的意思

en: Those heads contain impressively large brains, with a brain to body ratio similar to that of other intelligent animals,
zh: 章魚的頭裡有非常大的腦擁有與其它高智能生物相似的腦部身體比例

en: and a complex nervous system with about as many neurons as that of a dog.
zh: 及複雜的神經系統其神經元數量約和狗相當

notes.example: Repeating speech patterns strengthens motor neurons.

en: But instead of being centralized in the brain, these 500 million neurons are spread out in a network of interconnected ganglia
zh: 但這五億個神經元並非全部集中於腦部而是散佈在一個互連的神經節網絡中

notes.example: Repeating speech patterns strengthens motor neurons.

en: organized into three basic structures.
zh: 並分為三個基本結構

en: The central brain only contains about 10% of the neurons,
zh: 中樞腦部僅含約 10% 的神經元

notes.example: Repeating speech patterns strengthens motor neurons.

en: while the two huge optic lobes contain about 30%.
zh: 兩片龐大的視葉約含 30%

en: The other 60% are in the tentacles, which for humans would be like our arms having minds of their own.
zh: 剩餘的 60% 則位在觸手中這就好比人類的手臂擁有自己的智能一樣

en: This is where things get even more interesting.
zh: 這也是事情變得更有趣的地方

en: Vertebrates like us have a rigid skeleton to support our bodies, with joints that allow us to move.
zh: 像人類這樣的脊椎動物有著堅硬的骨骼以支撐身體還有關節可使我們移動身體

en: But not all types of movement are allowed.
zh: 卻不是每種動作都做得出來

en: You can't bend your knee backwards, or bend your forearm in the middle, for example.
zh: 例如，你無法向後屈膝或是彎曲前臂的中間部分

en: Cephalopods, on the other hand, have no bones at all, allowing them to bend their limbs at any point and in any direction.
zh: 但是，頭足類動物完全沒有骨骼讓牠們可以在肢體的任何一點往任何方向彎曲

en: So shaping their tentacles into any one of the virtually limitless number of possible arrangements
zh: 因此彎曲觸手做出幾乎無限可能的各種動作

en: is unlike anything we are used to.
zh: 並不是我們慣見的事

en: Consider a simple task, like grabbing and eating an apple.
zh: 設想一個簡單的動作例如拿取並吃下一顆蘋果

en: The human brain contains a neurological map of our body.
zh: 人類的大腦有身體的神經地圖

en: When you see the apple, your brain's motor center activates the appropriate muscles, allowing you to reach out with your arm,
zh: 當你看到蘋果大腦運動中樞會啟動相應的肌肉讓你能伸出手臂

en: grab it with your hand, bend your elbow joint, and bring it to your mouth.
zh: 用手拿取蘋果彎曲手肘關節再送入口中

en: For an octopus, the process is quite different.
zh: 對章魚而言該過程則完全不同

en: Rather than a body map, the cephalopod brain has a behavior library.
zh: 章魚的腦部沒有身體地圖卻有個行為圖書館

en: So when an octopus sees food, its brain doesn't activate a specific body part,
zh: 當章魚看到食物牠的腦部不會啟動特定的身體部位

en: but rather a behavioral response to grab.
zh: 卻會啟動一套行為反應以抓取食物

en: As the signal travels through the network, the arm neurons pick up the message and jump into action to command the movement.
zh: 信號在網絡內傳導腕足的神經元收到信號馬上開始動作

notes.example: Repeating speech patterns strengthens motor neurons.

notes.zh: pick someone up：開車去接某人
notes.example: I can pick you up from the airport at seven.

en: As soon as the arm touches the food, a muscle activation wave travels all the way through the arm to its base,
zh: 一旦腕足接觸到食物肌肉活化波就會一路從腕足傳導到其基部

en: while the arm sends back another wave from the base to the tip.
zh: 同時腕足會從基部送另一種波到尖端

en: The signals meet halfway between the food and the base of the arm, letting it know to bend at that spot.
zh: 這兩波信號在食物與腕足基部中間相遇讓章魚知道要在此點彎曲

en: What all this means is that each of an octopus's eight arms can essentially think for itself.
zh: 這一切意味著章魚的八隻腕足每一隻基本上都可以自己思考

en: This gives it amazing flexibility and creativity when facing a new situation or problem,
zh: 因而賦予章魚驚人的靈活性及創造性以面對新的情況或問題

en: whether its opening a bottle to reach food, escaping through a maze, moving around in a new environment,
zh: 無論是打開瓶子拿食物還是從迷宮中脫逃在新環境裡走動

en: changing the texture and the color of its skin to blend into the scenery, or even mimicking other creatures to scare away enemies.
zh: 改變皮膚質地及顏色以融入背景甚至是模仿其它生物以退敵

en: Cephalopods may have evolved complex brains long before our vertebrate relatives.
zh: 頭足類或許比我們的脊椎動物近親更早演化出複雜的腦部

en: And octopus intelligence isn't just useful for octopuses.
zh: 而且章魚的智能不只對章魚有用

en: Their radically different nervous system and autonomously thinking appendages have inspired new research
zh: 牠們完全不同的神經系統及具自主思考能力的附肢啟發我們新的研究

en: in developing flexible robots made of soft materials.
zh: 開發以軟材質製造的高靈活性機器人

notes.zh: you made it!：你成功辦到了／準時趕上了！
notes.example: I'm so glad you made it before the rain started.

en: And studying how intelligence can arise along such a divergent evolutionary path
zh: 研究智能如何在這條完全不同的演化路徑上崛起

en: can help us understand more about intelligence and consciousness in general.
zh: 也能幫助我們更加瞭解智能與意識

en: Who knows what other forms of intelligent life are possible, or how they process the world around them.
zh: 誰知道還有什麼不同形式的智能生命存在及他們如何處理其四周的世界
